profile.summary: ARCL Organics Ltd. manufactures and sells resins, additives, hardeners, and specialized one-shot resins in India. The company offers amino and melamine resins, phenolic resins, and formaldehydes. It serves panel, animal feed, rubber, pharma, engineering, textile, paper, foundries, refractories, paints, tire, and various other industries.
